jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: independent art-direction proof for a 2D isometric fantasy town; one modular object, not a city background.
Visual language: an original hand-finished late-1990s / early-2000s Japanese online RPG environment sprite. Charming but structurally believable architecture, crisp readable shapes, painterly pixel-like texture clusters, tangible depth. Orthographic 2:1 ground axes (screen diagonals rise one for two across), vertical uprights; no fisheye or vanishing points. Sun fixed at screen upper left, cool darker right faces, clear soft-edged contact shadows. Bright neutral daylight, lively green where vegetation is present. No yellow cast, no brown overall grading. Original design rather than copying any named game's asset.
Wear follows construction: subtle runoff below ledges, soot near chimneys, moss at damp bases, exposed bevel highlights. Preserve main color masses. Avoid uniform dirt overlays, plastic surfaces, airbrush blur, excessive tiny random noise, cinematic bloom, photorealism, labels, watermarks, characters.
Frame the complete object with clear margin. Genuine transparent alpha background outside the object, not a checkerboard drawn into the image.
Subject: ONE two-storey small-town bakery, main storefront and entrance on the visible wall facing screen DOWN-LEFT, secondary wall faces down-right. A warm muted terracotta tile roof with a few slate replacement tiles, aged cream lime plaster, worn pale-grey stone plinth, dark timber rafters, chimney, recessed windows, restrained brick around oven chimney. Modest green shutters, a hanging unlettered bread-shaped sign, low entrance steps with rounded worn treads. Roof thickness and overhanging eaves must be obvious; cast shadow under tiles, individual tile rows, lit left and darker right wall. Rectangular square-aligned footprint; no crooked house, no surrounding scenery. Roof ridge and footprint align with the two ground axes. About 1000 px high source, designed to read when the door is 85 px high in game.
Shared world scale: adult 1.7 m, normal exterior door 2.1 m tall, storey 3.0 m, residential total height including roof 6.5–8.0 m, tree heights 6.8 / 5.0 / 3.8 m, curtain wall top 5.2 m, gate towers 8.0 m, main gate opening 3.2 m, bench seat 0.45 m, sidewalk riser 0.12 m. Interpret all components physically relative to those references, never oversize doors, steps, roof tiles, leaves or furniture. For game planning an adult projects to 72 px vertically; normal door about 89 px at the same gameplay zoom. Do not place a human or scale annotations in the image.
LOCK lighting across all assets: source located screen UPPER LEFT at approximately 45 degree elevation, every cast shadow runs LOWER RIGHT. Up/left planes get clear neutral daylight, right/down-facing planes receive cooler darker ambient fill. Keep shadow edges consistently moderately soft, not ink-black. Opposite-facing facades must NOT reverse the light source.

Subject: ONE reusable isometric street-corner ground module, wide aspect, a close but game-readable piece of city infrastructure. Two purple-blue-grey stone roads meet at a right angle in world coordinates (the 2:1 screen diagonals). Road stones laid in coherent staggered rectangular courses. The intersection corner has a deliberate 45-degree chamfer in WORLD space, so the curb is a articulated contour instead of two endless straight stripes. The sidewalk widens into a small landing at the chamfer. A small inner lawn island uses a gentle rounded curb return, with wedge-shaped corner stones and continuous top/side shading. These changes are carefully planned around walking circulation, not wavy random edges. Inside corner has pale worn limestone sidewalk, with an obvious 10–12 cm raised curb: narrow lit top, dark vertical riser, soft contact shadow onto lower road, beveled/chipped edge and distinct joints. One carefully sloped accessibility/cart ramp connects sidewalk to road at the corner, a small drain grate follows curb, sparse dirt in road seams. A small interior patch of fresh cool-green lawn and a low red-brown brick planting border help show elevations; no buildings, trees, characters or lamps. Ground ends cleanly at asset boundary with transparency beyond, not a tall floating platform. No perspective shrinking. Road must be flat and walkable; sidewalk/curb have true visible step height. Surface detail readable without looking like scattered pebbles or noise.
